cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# Benchmark test
add_executable(benchmark_test benchmark_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(benchmark_test PRIVATE ThreadPool_static)
target_include_directories(benchmark_test PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)

# Load test
add_executable(load_test load_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(load_test PRIVATE ThreadPool_static)
target_include_directories(load_test PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)

# Stress test
add_executable(stress_test stress_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(stress_test PRIVATE ThreadPool_static)
target_include_directories(stress_test PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)

# Register with CTest
add_test(NAME benchmark_test COMMAND benchmark_test)
add_test(NAME load_test COMMAND load_test)
add_test(NAME stress_test COMMAND stress_test)
